current_evidence: The Authority's validation-guidance page (peakdistrict.gov.uk/planning/your-application/validation-guidance) links this Aug 2026 'Local Validation Guidance List' as the only list; the page text shows no date and the PDF itself returned a client error, so Grokbot's 'Revised 06 August 2026' could not be confirmed from the text.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the adopted local list matrix applies many local items to Householder: L1.1-L1.6 site/block plans, elevations, detailed elevations, floor plans, roof plans, cross-sections/levels; L2.2 climate change statement; L2.3 affordable housing statement; L4.1 FRA; L6 tree survey; L7.1 protected species form; L7.2 ecological survey; L9 landscaping scheme; L10 lighting assessment; L11.1-L11.4 archaeology DBA, archaeological evaluation, heritage statement, structural survey.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 Local validation list (adopted 18 July 2025), requirements-by-application-type table, H column

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Variation of condition (s73), Non-material amendment and Lawful development certificate are all recorded as '(none)', but the matrix ticks most L-items for Outline and VC, and L1.x plans / planning statement / landscaping for RM, NMA and LDC.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 table: O and VC columns ticked for L1.1-L17; RM ticked for L1.1-L1.6, L2.1, L3, L6, L9, L11.3

issues.detail: Listed building consent only gets archaeology DBA, heritage statement and structural survey; source also applies L1.1-L1.6 plans, L7.1 protected species form, L7.2 ecological survey and L11.2 archaeological evaluation. Advertisement consent only gets heritage statement; source also applies L1.1-L1.4 plans, L2.1 planning statement and L10 lighting assessment.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 table, LBC and AD columns

issues.detail: About 33 requirements are placed under Full planning with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning', even though the source has an explicit application-type matrix (e.g. Advertisement drawings/illumination details put under Full planning; Affordable housing statement and Lighting assessment also apply to Householder).
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 table key: H, F, O, RM, LBC, AD, LDC, NMA, VC, ADC

issues.detail: Not captured: L2.2 Climate change statement (H, F, O, RM, VC); L2.4 Agricultural development statement (F, O, VC); L7.1 Protected species form; L7.3 Geological survey and assessment; L11.2 Archaeological evaluation; L8.2 Landscape visual appraisal (distinct from LVIA); L1.3 Detailed elevation drawings.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1 table rows L2.2, L2.4, L7.1, L7.3, L8.2, L11.2, L1.3

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has a trigger excerpt about the Arboricultural Method Statement; 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement Impact Assessment' is actually the L5 Hydrology/hydrogeology statement; 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' text is part of the planning/agricultural statement guidance. Several excerpts are cut fragments ('hours of illumination), and should be accompanied by drawings...', 'operation and parking provision.', 'of any playing fields or sports facilities.', 'trees then ecological surveys may also be required (L7.1).').
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt vs L-headings in source

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' (Full planning and Minerals & waste rows) is advice about the paid pre-app service, not a validation requirement; tab items 'These details can be annotated on the plan, if appropriate.' and the HRA definition sentence ('This includes existing and proposed Special Areas of Conservation...') are fragments rather than requirements.
issues.evidence: trigger: 'a paid pre-application advice service if further guidance is required.'

issues.detail: List date recorded as 2026-08-01 while the date basis says 'Revised 06 August 2026'; the stored date should be 2026-08-06 if that text is correct. The underlying list was adopted 18 July 2025.
issues.evidence: Appendix 1: 'adopted 18 July 2025'; workbook Date basis 'Revised 06 August 2026'

summary: Grokbot's link is the list the Authority currently publishes, but the PDF could not be fetched; checked against the adopted 2025 requirements-by-application-type matrix, Grokbot wrongly shows no local requirements for Householder, Outline, RM, s73, NMA and LDC and dumps everything else under Full planning as 'inferred'. Note that the Aug 2026 revision may differ in detail from the 2025 matrix used here.
